thread.title: Nasdaq falls 1% in volatile session as Amazon weighs - MarketWatch

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: Nasdaq falls 1% in volatile session as Amazon weighs - MarketWatch
text: The Nasdaq Composite Index fell on Wednesday, dropping in a volatile session that saw it swing between steep losses and positive territory. The index COMP, -0.92% sank 1.3%, the latest example of heavy volatility for the tech-heavy market gauge. One of the biggest drags on the Nasdaq was Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -6.26% which tumbled 6.1% in what was on track to be its biggest one-day percentage decline since Feb. 5, 2016. Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.83% also pressured the Nasdaq, falling 1.2%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.02% fell 0.2% while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.24% was off 0.4%. The Nasdaq is set for its fifth decline of the past six sessions, and it is down 4.7% for the month of March, set for its biggest monthly drop since January 2016.
